prompt:
Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Fixed: `# Hello world !` now gets the id `hello-world` with no trailing dash. In `slugify` in `markdown/extensions/toc.py`, removing the `!` left a space at the end of the text, and that space became a dash. The fix trims leading and trailing whitespace before the spaces are turned into separators, so this also covers headings that start with punctuation, like `# ! Hello world`. I added two regression tests (one also checks `slugify_unicode`); both fail without the fix and pass with it. I also added a changelog entry. The full suite passes (1131 tests). It skipped 112 tests, although CLAUDE.md says only two should be skipped; I didn't look into why.
